note: Ownership only. Source status and acceptance remain authoritative; no fix is claimed by assignment.

items.title: Fail closed on missing verification gates
items.acceptance: Blank and whitespace-only gates return not-met; CLI refuses to run tasks when it cannot derive a gate; valid exit-zero commands can pass.

items.title: Keep JSON parseable under meter pressure and protocol warnings
items.acceptance: JSON.parse remains valid for parseable JSON tool results during meter warn/handoff; exact retrieval remains byte-identical. Non-JSON advisories retain current behavior.

items.title: Enforce advertised input schemas at runtime
items.acceptance: SDK calls with omitted required fields, wrong primitive types, unknown properties, invalid enums and wrong array item types are rejected before handler execution; valid requests still work.

items.title: Invalidate graph facts after edits, additions and deletions
items.acceptance: Same-process and reopened-cache tests observe modified exports/imports, new files and deleted nodes without a manual rescan; reindex cost measured on a declared corpus.

items.title: Stop substring matches from verifying false claims
items.acceptance: A file exporting foobar contradicts exports foo; similarly named files/imports cannot verify each other; aliases, NodeNext paths and ambiguous module tails have explicit tests.

items.title: Separate lifetime savings, session savings and live-window occupancy
items.acceptance: A fresh session with no optimization reports zero session savings despite lifetime history; replayed requests and MCP-plus-proxy paths cannot double-count the same replacement.

items.title: Do not invent a larger context window when usage exceeds a configured limit
items.acceptance: 210k observed in a configured 200k window stays overflow/handoff, not healthy at 21%; unknown models remain labelled unknown and host-specific capacities are tested.

items.title: Apply never-expand and savings accounting to the final emitted response
items.acceptance: The 86-token fixture no longer emits 108 tokens while reporting a saving; sweep boundary-sized payloads, long file paths and warnings for read, optimize, hooks and proxy.

items.title: Classify polite action requests and inflected write verbs correctly
items.acceptance: Can you fix the bug? and Create a complete audit report and map needed fixes are actionable; explain the architecture remains inquiry. Report confusion matrix on a versioned task corpus.

items.title: Use domain relevance and abstention for skill selection
items.acceptance: Local resume regressions remain green; payments-discovery no longer wins an MCP audit via map/evidence alone; domain-labelled corpus and healthy/unhealthy skill cases pass.

items.title: Promote resilient bounded scanning from local checkout to reviewed delivery
items.acceptance: EPERM/EACCES/disappearing children preserve readable siblings; inaccessible root and EIO still fail; symlink cycles stop; active-host root and coverage diagnostics verified after restart.

items.title: Make recall lifetime and purge policy explicit
items.acceptance: Hot/cold round trips and corruption checks pass; eviction cannot silently remove pinned live handles; missing/expired handles return actionable errors; docs match server startup maintenance.

items.title: Use one explicit project root for identity, queries and commands
items.acceptance: Server launched outside the overridden project searches and verifies the intended project; nested worktrees and two simultaneous projects cannot share the wrong state.

items.title: Prove concurrent read-modify-write safety and crash recovery
items.acceptance: Multiprocess increments preserve exact expected totals; interleaved manifest writes preserve all handles; injected crash and corrupt-state recovery is deterministic and observable.

items.title: Fail closed when requested worker isolation cannot be created
items.acceptance: Injected worktree creation failure runs zero agent commands in the shared checkout; independent-worker results cannot mark integrated acceptance met before reconciliation.

items.title: Enforce deadlines inside subprocesses and surface incomplete exit semantics
items.acceptance: Hanging child cannot outlive the declared deadline beyond bounded teardown; max/time-budget stops with unfinished tasks are machine-distinguishable from goal-met across MCP, CLI and fan.

items.title: Return useful verification failure evidence and scope success to the actual command
items.acceptance: Distinct compile/test/timeout failures retain differentiating evidence without credentials; a passing trivial command cannot be described as full task/rubric acceptance.

items.title: Fix the published library quickstart
items.acceptance: A fresh consumer copies the README example and recovers the exact original; no missing method or undocumented option is required.

items.title: Track source, installed binary, active MCP and npm as distinct artifacts
items.acceptance: Document npm 0.20.0 versus main 0.20.1; packed candidate and active-host smoke each attest their own artifact. Rollback/restart instructions tested separately.

items.title: Triage and remediate existing upstream runtime advisories
items.acceptance: npm audit --omit=dev has zero critical/high, or a reviewed time-bounded exception with reachability evidence; lockfile install, full verify and packed-consumer tests pass. Current report is not an exploit demonstration.

items.title: Require review and status checks on main
items.acceptance: GitHub API proves the active rule targets main and requires the intended checks/review; a failing PR cannot merge via the normal path. No organization/admin settings changed by this map.

items.title: Harden CI supply chain and reproducibility
items.acceptance: Every external action has an attested revision; untrusted PR jobs have no write token/secrets; timed-out builds terminate; required-check names are stable.

items.title: Extend existing green tests with adversarial end-to-end contracts
items.acceptance: Each P0/P1 fix has a red-before/green-after test; default strictness and error paths are exercised through stdio, not just direct handler calls; skipped live tests stay labelled.

items.title: Measure task fidelity and net session benefit, not just round-trip availability
items.acceptance: Report raw/emitted/recall/retry/tool-schema tokens, correctness, completion rate, latency and cost on the same tasks; no claimed universal answer preservation or provider-billed savings from token heuristics alone.

items.title: Bound full scans, repeated reads, tokenization and deep-parse work
items.acceptance: Publish dataset sizes, machine/runtime, cold/warm p50/p95, memory and event-loop delay; no tuning accepted if task fidelity regresses. Budgets set from measurements, not invented speedups.

items.title: Prove enforcement in actual supported hosts
items.acceptance: For every claimed platform, record version and real lifecycle evidence or label unverified/advisory; OAuth tool-surface savings remain separate from API-proxy measurements.

items.title: Verify setup, upgrades, reconnect and removal without clobbering host config
items.acceptance: Fresh install and upgrade preserve unrelated settings; reconnect reports the expected binary/root and passes read/recall/search probes; no live configuration changed silently.

items.title: Review sensitive local retention and optional network boundaries
items.acceptance: Synthetic secret canaries prove intended redaction and isolation; raw exact-recall storage is disclosed accurately; permissions and hub/proxy access controls tested. Novel vulnerability details stay private under SECURITY.md.

items.title: Bound enforcement claims to the actual permission mechanism
items.acceptance: A versioned command/host matrix tests direct and equivalent command forms plus missing/broken hooks; unsupported constraints are labelled unenforced rather than advertised as physically guaranteed.

items.title: Measure standing protocol/tool-schema overhead and response verbosity
items.acceptance: Record cold session overhead plus per-task tool/result tokens before/after; retain required operating guidance and do not attribute host-added repetition to source without measurement.

items.title: Keep one traceable public repair backlog and review workflow
items.acceptance: All IDs, sources, evidence fragments and dependencies validate; tool inventory covers all 37 tools; the public branch/PR identifies implemented versus open work and preserves private security disclosure.

items.title: Align declared Node support and actual CI coverage
items.acceptance: Declared minimum can install/run the packed artifact; CI matrix matches policy; compatibility changes get explicit release notes, not an untested engine claim.
